output.reason: The linked PR [ev-1fce1f0da042] makes the one-line note [ev-1708c9a8a9a2] concrete. Crossplane now builds the names of an XR's composed resources from the parent XR's UID and the resource's key in the composition pipeline, shortened if too long, in the form `<PrefixForComposed>-<CompositionResourceName>-<Parent UID>`. [ev-8fffb964c43c] gives the old behaviour: when composed resources listed in spec.resourceRefs were missing or had failed to be created, the function pipeline gave them new random names instead of reusing the existing ones. That is enough to write applicability (XRs that compose resources through the function pipeline) and consequence (resources created for them after the upgrade get deterministic names instead of random ones, so missing resources are recreated under consistent names). The confidence is low because the shown text is cut off and doesn't say whether children that already exist get renamed.
